findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Yogurts for breakfast service were not kept on ice. These items were returned to the reach in cooler where they were found to be 55F internally. The yogurts were discarded. Yogurt reads keep refrigerated on the label. Take care to properly handle food according to label directions. The violation is considered corrected at the time of inspection. 

(A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Inspector observed employee properly wash hands and then on her walk to the glove box, take the collar of her shirt and dab her upper lip. The employee was stopped in the process of putting on gloves. Gloves were discarded and hands properly washed. Employee was coached on proper glove use. 

2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the sanitation bucket to be at 100ppm of Quat. The facility usually changes the bucket at 10:30 am. The sanitizer bucket was refreshed and now reads 400ppm of quat. Discussed with manager that this task be assigned. The violation is considered corrected on site. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a container of sanitizing wipes to be stored on the top shelf of the cabinet over food items. The container was removed to the chemical storage area. Take care to maintain chemicals stored properly. The violation is considered to be corrected on site. 

7-201.11: (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Another live roach was observed in the dish machine area at today’s inspection. The facility was treated on 9/14/23. The PCO stated that they should wait until the bait is effective. Roaches were first observed in April and bait was applied at that visit. It is 6 months later and roach activity is yet observable at this inspection. Please provide treatment that will eliminate pest activity.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. 

Reattach base cove in any areas observed throughout kitchen and ensure that all floor wall gaps are sealed as to not provide harborage for pests. Correct as soon as possible to support pest control efforts.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 

The facility leaves the back door open for air flow. The screen door has some light at the bottom and the screens themselves have gaps in areas. Close the kitchen door or repair the screened in vestibule area.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

One roach was observed in the dish machine area. The PCO stated that bait was used during the 8/23/23 visit.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation. 

The facility has a milk cooler with a seal that is torn and in disrepair. The facility has asked for the seal to be replaced and has had no success. Please repair/replace the seals on the milk coolers.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

The facility has had a new chemical dispenser that has been attached to a piece of raw wood. Seal the wood base of the chemical dispenser. Also, shelves attached to the wall above the 3 part sink have areas around the edges that are not sealed. The two cabinets are not sealed together so that the gap can provide a harborage. Seal all areas in the kitchen that could provide harborage to pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. 

The facility has an area of base cove across from the dish machine that is pulling away from the wall. Reattach base cove in any areas observed throughout kitchen. Correct as soon as possible to support pest control efforts.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled. (E) WHOLE-MUSCLE BEEF shall be from approved source and acceptable from AUTHROITY. Pf (D) FISH must be frozen if consumed undercooked. (F) Meat and Poultry shall be properly labeled. (G) Eggs shall be properly labeled. C
Observed a partial bag of cheese sauce in the warmer reheating. The cheese sauce is at 150F two hours after it had been added to the warmer. The cheese sauce was discarded in the garbage. Discussion on the proper cooling and reheating of foods took place and the facility manager made the determination that they would not do cooling and reheating of foods. They will operate as a medium risk facility and according to their permit.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material. 
The bottom of the chest freezer holding juices and bread is lined with cardboard. Remove cardboard. The bottom of the unit can have soda crates or other cleanable material to line the bottom and keep boxes from sticking to the bottom of the freezer.
